method: 90 raw rAF intervals per capture after a 1 s settle. Shared laptop; repository tests ran concurrently with visual QA. These timings are load-contaminated observations, not a controlled performance comparison or separate CPU/GPU measurement. Memory is an RGBA+mipmap/buffer estimate, not measured device allocation.
checks: source olive versus cool grey: colour only, no snow, identical normal/roughness, terrain, cameras and lights
same geometry and world export; seven field overlays; matched cameras and lighting
normal snow-free; cold potential on/off; Low, night, low sun, tablet touch; three seeds; unzoned fallback and reference return

sources.method: Pearson luminance autocorrelation at original source repeat in X and Y; exact periodic baseline is 1. Seam error compares atlas wrap-neighbour differences to interior neighbour differences. These are source-space measures, not a visual acceptance substitute.
